The current iteration of `plane.js` renders passenger windows as individual dark boxes along the fuselage. The previous score was impacted because some windows were erroneously placed outside the main body or appeared too dot-like due to their spacing. 

By adjusting the window loop limit from `i < 62` to `i < 50`, I have ensured that the windows are correctly localized within the wide section of the fuselage (spanning approximately $\pm 23$ units) while maintaining a reasonable density. This helps create a more coherent passenger deck line by eliminating "floating" dots while keeping the geometry simple enough to avoid previous regressions.

I will now monitor the results of this change in the next judging cycle.
